subject: world_language
concept: Reconstructing arguments and information from several complex spoken or written sources into a coherent, unified presentation
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR C2 'summarize information from different sources, reconstructing arguments in coherent presentation' descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student organizes arguments from several complex sources into a single coherent presentation outline
exercise.abstract: Student synthesizes several complex sources into one coherent, unified spoken or written presentation in the target language

assessment.mastery_threshold: presentation integrates multiple sources into one genuinely unified argument, not a sequential summary of each
misconception_flags: presents each source's argument sequentially rather than genuinely reconstructing them into one unified whole

interest_binding: sources generated fresh from student's stated interest profile where possible
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
